in_marathi.name: Niraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nirajas', meaning 'radiant', 'shining', or 'unblemished'. In Hindu mythology, Niraj is a name of the god Vishnu, symbolizing his unblemished, pure, and radiant nature. This name is believed to bestow the qualities of purity, radiance, and brilliance upon the bearer.
